gdpr.title: Data & privacy
gdpr.subtitle: Download a copy of your data or permanently delete your organization.
gdpr.exportBody: Download a JSON file containing every record linked to your organization: customers, invoices, products, payments, stock and more.
gdpr.deleteBody: This removes all personal data for your organization and customers, revokes every user's access, and clears Fortnox tokens. Accounting records (invoices, line items, payments) are retained in anonymised form for 7 years as required by Swedish bokföringslagen. This cannot be undone.
gdpr.bokforing_export_description: Download a ZIP bundle with every invoice PDF, the full audit log (CSV) and a machine-readable ledger.json — formatted for your accountant and meeting Swedish bokföringslagen 7-year retention requirements.
gdpr.sie4_export_description: Download a SIE4 file (the Swedish accounting interchange format) containing every invoice for the current fiscal year. Ready to import into Fortnox, Visma, Bokio or any other BAS-aware system.

hero.sub: Inventory, invoicing, POS, and AI-driven insights — all in one platform. Replace Excel, Fortnox copy-paste, and guesswork with one tab that does everything.
hero.disclaimer: 14-day free trial · No credit card required · Cancel any time

features.sub: No add-ons to install, no integrations to babysit, no consultants to call. One product that does the whole job.
features.f1b: Live stock across every warehouse. Low-stock alerts fire before customers notice. Goods-in and adjustment records in seconds.
features.f2b: 25 / 12 / 6 % VAT baked in. PDF export, payment tracking, automatic overdue detection — no Fortnox copy-paste ever again.
features.f3b: Aging reports show 30 / 60 / 90+ day buckets at a glance. Always know what's outstanding and what's overdue.
features.f4b: Fast checkout with barcode scanning, split payments, and automatic stock deduction. Works offline, syncs when you reconnect.
features.f5b: Flags cash-flow risks, suggests reorder quantities, and drafts purchase orders — before you even think to ask.
features.f6b: See your fastest movers and seasonal patterns. Auto-generated POs based on real historical movement data.

steps.s2b: Upload products, customers, and opening stock from CSV or Excel.
steps.s3b: Issue invoices, manage inventory, and accept payments — all in one tab.
